summary: CareerOS Radar V2 fixes (IPS Radar calibration — 8 criteria rescaled to 100, provisional summary, excerpt flag; portal settings UX — unsaved-close confirm, sticky save, summary + warning toasts, 'À vérifier' row; SourceStatus 'Aucun portail configuré'; today marker + history + GET /runs; mobile 390px overflow; regression pack IPS official) backend+frontend testing. Backend: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_radar.py → 24 passed + 1 skipped (pack-stage IPS skipped because the application created by the pack test is still generating; shape is validated separately on the seed pack). New assertions added: ips.stage=='radar', len(criteria)==8 with qualite_lettre/force_reseau excluded, priority matches thresholds (A: ips>=70 & gf>=6 & no KO; B: ips>=50 & no KO; else C), decision_report.summary starts with 'IPS Radar CareerOS :' and contains '(provisoire, recalculé dans le pack)', GET /api/careeros/radar/runs?days=30 returns a list with each run containing 'at'+'status' and no 'user_id' leak, offer document carries 'excerpt' field. Existing coverage preserved (settings + portal detect + run/dashboard shape + dedupe + ignore/pack + CO code + cross-member 404 + cron 401/200 + email draft + PATCH 'pret' + interview + .ics). Frontend /careeros/radar: Radar page renders 42 offers; each offer card shows IPS Radar N (radar-ips-{id}) and the decision summary beginning with 'IPS Radar CareerOS : N/100 — priorité X (provisoire, recalculé dans le pack).' (sampled 3 cards: 54/B, 51/B, 40/C — all consistent with thresholds). Today marker (radar-today-marker) text 'Recherche effectuée aujourd'hui · Automatique : faite à 22 h 32 · 12 manuelle(s)' and radar-history-day-2026-10-12 rendered. SourceStatus counts: workday=58 offres (green), boards=37 offres (green), jooble/adzuna='Non configuré' (amber). Settings dialog: unsaved change + Escape triggers window.confirm 'Vos modifications ne sont pas enregistrées. Fermer sans enregistrer ?' — dismiss keeps dialog open, accept closes it. Sticky save button visible with long list (bbox y=854 at bottom of viewport). Import list ('FooTest | https://example.com/careers' + 'BarTest | https://barboards.greenhouse.io/bartest'): after Save, summary toast 'Réglages enregistrés : 4 portail(s) Workday, 2 site(s) carrières, 2 entreprise(s) via Jooble.' + warning toast 'URL non reconnue pour : FooTest. Ces entreprises sont suivies via Jooble.' both shown; reopening dialog shows FooTest row with 'À vérifier' button (radar-company-check-6) and BarTest row with green 'Greenhouse' kind badge (radar-company-kind-7). Disabling all Workday companies + Save → radar-source-count-workday = 'Aucun portail configuré'; re-enabling + Save restored 'workday · 58 offres'. Mobile 390px: documentElement.scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390 → no horizontal overflow. Member seed restored to the required 6 companies (Desjardins/Intelcom/Walmart/Couche-Tard Workday + Amazon amazon + Hydro-Québec no URL), confirmed via GET /radar/settings.
critical_code_review_comments: radar.py ensure_radar_indexes migrates ips.stage!='radar' at startup by RECOMPUTING points via compute_ips (no AI call), but the migration also overwrites the offer's 'decision_report' using the newly-computed ips.score/priority on top of the OLD decision_report body — fine, since only the summary is regenerated from the official template, but worth verifying no stale 'IPS officiel' text remains in the long-form 'why' field. Current UI shows the new provisional summary everywhere.
RadarSettings.jsx `close` uses window.confirm (per spec). Works but is unstylable; a shadcn AlertDialog would match the rest of the app. Minor.

RadarSettings.jsx keywords input still uses defaultValue + onBlur (flagged in iteration_21/22). Not a regression but a latent UX hazard on Safari when user types then immediately clicks Save without blurring. Prefer value/onChange.

SourceStatus.jsx: when a kind becomes 'Aucun portail configuré' the pill color stays amber — great signal — but the component still shows 'Workday' / 'Sites carrières' labels. Consider greying the label too for extra clarity. Non-blocking.

radar.py `/dashboard` sources_status.portals groups amazon/greenhouse/lever/ashby under 'boards' — correct, but if a user only has 'amazon' companies the UI reads 'Sites carrières'. Consider future-proofing with per-kind counts (workday, greenhouse, lever, ashby, amazon) once more members configure Lever/Ashby.
radar.py cron users-collection uses list+'if not in users' O(n^2) — flagged in iteration_21, still present (minor at current scale).
No new API-level rate limiting on /portal/detect (flagged previously). Still minor — authenticated endpoint only.

success_rate.backend: 100% (24/24 ran, 1 skipped as pack IPS not yet generated)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily added companies FooTest + BarTest via UI import to exercise the recognized/unrecognized paths; removed both before restoring. Also toggled off+on all Workday companies to validate 'Aucun portail configuré'. Final state verified via GET /api/careeros/radar/settings: Desjardins, Intelcom, Walmart, Couche-Tard, Amazon, Hydro-Québec (all enabled, correct portal_url/kind as per request).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_radar.py (24 tests + 1 conditional skip, ~35s). Daily limit of 50 analyses is still hit on membre.test (analyzed_today=50/50) — any new /run will yield analyzed=0 and that is expected until the next calendar day. Jooble/Adzuna remain unset (configured.jooble=false, configured.adzuna=false); 'excerpt' field exists on every offer and is False for all current offers (none from Jooble). The migration in ensure_radar_indexes already backfilled stage='radar' for existing offers (verified: all offers surface 'IPS Radar' and provisional summary). RADAR_CRON_SECRET read from /app/backend/.env still works. CO code generation on pack intact.
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs reproduced. All Radar V2 acceptance criteria confirmed on preview.
